source: Entirely invented profiles, companies, projects and labels; no production data, resumes or employer applications.
label_author: Repository-authored synthetic relevance rubric; not independently human-annotated or hiring-outcome labels.
split_policy: Domain-group split; no ranking domain appears in both dev and heldout. Different task families may reuse a synthetic domain, so do not use another task to tune heldout ranking.
freeze_rule: Thresholds and alpha are declared before the first BGE evaluation. If heldout adoption fails, retain lexical default; do not retune on these heldout labels.
